Usage: mail-find resolve <ref> [flags]

Turn a Message-ID, or a message:// link from a mail client, into the message's id.

Finds the message a person is looking at in their mail client. The
Message-ID is the one identifier every client and provider agree on. A
message dragged out of Apple Mail arrives as a message:// link holding it,
percent-encoded, and resolve decodes that.

Arguments:
  <ref>                    A Message-ID header value, with or without its angle brackets, or a
                           message:// link.

Inherited flags:
  -h, --help               Show context-sensitive help.
      --account=ACCOUNT    Which account's mailbox to read. An id from one account means nothing in
                           the other (default: gmail; one of: gmail, outlook).
      --text               Print the human form instead of one JSON document.

Examples:
  mail-find resolve '<6a8976c5.4a0b@mail.example>'
  mail-find resolve 'message://%3C6a8976c5.4a0b@mail.example%3E'

JSON:
  One message's envelope, as search prints a hit: id, conversation_id,
  message_id, date, from, to, cc, subject and snippet.

Exit codes:
  0    success
  1    failed
  2    invalid arguments; nothing was run
